package.name: vi_local_planner
package.description: Value-iteration local planner for Nav2: a Rust node that serves the follow_path action (nav2_msgs) by refining the solved value function inside a moving local window with laser-scan penalties (the ValueIteratorLocal scheme of the original value_iteration package) and publishing the greedy action as cmd_vel. Drop-in replacement for nav2_controller's controller_server.
